title: Chia Pudding with Blueberries
excerpt: Enjoy a creamy, fresh breakfast with this chia pudding made with plant-based milk, lightly sweetened and served with a generous layer of Fresh Pick blueberries.
imageAlt: Glass jar of creamy chia pudding with layers of fresh Fresh Pick blueberries on a wooden table.

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 cups almond, coconut or whole milk

steps: In a bowl or glass jar, pour the milk of your choice, the chia seeds, the vanilla, the honey and the lemon zest.
Stir very well for 2 minutes with a fork to make sure the chia seeds mix in and don’t stick to the bottom.
Let the mixture rest for 10 minutes at room temperature and whisk again with the fork to break up any lumps that formed.
Cover the container and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or ideally overnight, until it reaches a firm, creamy consistency.
Before serving, gently rinse the Fresh Pick blueberries. These high-mountain blueberries, grown in Guasca, have the perfectly balanced sweetness to go with the chia.
Serve the chia pudding in two glasses or cups, alternating layers of pudding with the fresh blueberries on top.
tips: To keep the natural protective coating and all the freshness of Fresh Pick blueberries, keep them refrigerated in their box and wash them only a few minutes before eating them.
If you like a completely smooth, even texture, you can blend the milk with the chia and the honey before refrigerating the mixture.
